title: The Derelict Colony
logline: A stubborn elder refuses to evacuate their failing station, hiring a pilot to fight off a scrapper guild trying to dismantle it around them.

roles.description: Old, fiercely proud, surrounded by memories.
Practical, completely unsentimental, views the station as just metal.
A rusted, failing habitat in a lifeless system.
A heavy industrial ship fitted with plasma cutters.
A tough union of deep-space salvagers.

public_situation: The {role:abandoned_station} has been officially declared dead by the local government, and salvage rights have been sold to the {role:scrapper_guild}.
private_truth: The elder is still living inside, desperately trying to keep the core active so the station's historical archives aren't lost forever.

beats.public_change: The scrapper guild arrives and begins cutting into the station's outer ring.

missions.reason: The elder asks the pilot to mine and deliver ferrite to patch the hull breaches caused by the scrappers.
missions.private_fact: The elder's life support is failing, and they are rationing oxygen just to talk.

beats.public_change: The scrapper guild issues a final warning for any squatters to vacate.

missions.reason: The scrapper hires the pilot to run a deep scan of the station to prove there are no life signs.
missions.private_fact: The scan clearly shows the elder is alive, but the scrapper asks the pilot to falsify the report.

beats.public_change: The scrappers begin cutting into the main archive core.

missions.reason: The elder pays the pilot to destroy the scrapper tug and recover its master cutting keys to stop the demolition.
missions.private_fact: The scrapper hails the pilot, offering to split the salvage bounty if they help finish tearing the station apart.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the scrapper tug.
resolutions.summary: The scrappers retreat. The elder secures the station and its archives, though they remain completely alone in the dead system.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought off a salvage crew to protect a stubborn old hermit.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the scrapper's offer.
resolutions.summary: The station is torn apart. The archives are destroyed, and the elder is forcefully evacuated. The pilot is paid well.
The scrappers accidentally cut into a pressurized section, blowing the elder out into space. The salvage is completed quietly.

loose_threads.detail: The elder wasn't just protecting history; the archives contain the coordinates of a lost first-wave colonist cache.
The scrappers were specifically paid by the local government to destroy the archives before they could be read.

radio_hooks: {role:scrapper_guild} reports minor delays due to "technical issues".

voice_direction.stubborn_elder: Quiet, dignified, refuses to show weakness.
voice_direction.ruthless_scrapper: Loud, cheerful, treats everything like a joke.
